title: BlobUploadResponse::sha256 doc says lowercase hex; validator accepts uppercase
description: BlobUploadResponse::sha256 doc says 'SHA-256 hex digest of the uploaded blob as 64 lowercase hex characters'. A server returning uppercase hex (non-conformant but real) will pass validate_sha256_format because is_ascii_hexdigit() accepts A-F. The doc should say 'hex characters (lowercase per JMAP-CID; uppercase accepted)' to match the actual behavior and prevent a caller from assuming the field is always lowercase.
